description: The execution procedure temporarily reset the active branch HEAD and used git stash/stash pop to satisfy historical commit checks in the safety guard. While the execution successfully proved the Firestore capability and was isolated, resetting the active branch worktree violates the standing repo-safety lock.
mitigation_policy_future_agents: Safety guard satisfy commands must never reset/stash/restore/clean the active branch/worktree. Detached worktrees, read-only git show, or worktree-independent inspections must be used instead.
